headline: Breaking up (with Elon Musk) is hard to do
summary: Shivon Zilis publicly announced her breakup with Elon Musk on X. The announcement was made by quote-tweeting an account that monitors social media activity. This public disclosure brings back memories of old-school internet drama.

headline: Rivian’s sales pop as the company’s big R2 bet starts to pay off
summary: Rivian reported strong Q3 production and delivery numbers. The company produced 19,751 vehicles and delivered 19,248, a significant year-over-year increase. This success indicates that the more affordable R2 model is proving popular.

headline: Beehiiv creators are buzzing about a new price increase
summary: Creator platform Beehiiv is raising its prices, causing dissatisfaction among many users. CEO Tyler Denk states the increase is necessary to continue investing in the core platform. Beehiiv has gained popularity as an alternative to Substack.

headline: Nacon’s new PS5 controller can mix audio from your phone and console
summary: Nacon unveiled the Revolution 5 Unlimited, an officially licensed PS5 controller with a built-in screen. The screen allows on-the-fly adjustments for settings like joystick sensitivity and button remapping. It can also mix audio from both your phone and console simultaneously.

headline: GTA 6 Age Rating Confirms New Details on Sex, Drug Use, Decapitation, and More
summary: GTA 6 has received a PEGI 18 rating, revealing mature content details. The rating mentions instances of "decapitation" and "scenes of sexual fetishes." Players will reportedly have the ability to snort cocaine at any time.

headline: Save 31% Off the Gamesir G7 Pro, One of the Best Wireless PC Gaming Controllers for (Way) Under $100
summary: The Gamesir G7 Pro wireless PC gaming controller is currently 31% off. This highly-rated controller is now available for under $100. This deal is considered to be even better than typical Prime Day offers.

headline: 4 Things to Focus on Outside Combat in Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave
summary: This article explores four crucial aspects of gameplay beyond combat in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. It guides players on optimizing their experience with non-battle activities. Focusing on these elements can enhance strategy and character development.

headline: The AOC 16" Portable USB Monitor For Laptop, Switch, or Gaming Handheld Drops to $47.49 for Prime Day
summary: The AOC 16" portable USB monitor is on sale for just $47.49. It's perfect for use as a secondary screen for laptops. This portable display is also ideal for Nintendo Switch or other gaming handhelds.

headline: Watch: Why has UK diesel price hit an all time high?
summary: UK diesel prices have reached an all-time high, averaging £2 a litre. The RAC motoring group confirmed this record price. Petrol prices in the UK are also experiencing a rise.

headline: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
summary: Riot police have confronted students amid widespread education protests across France. Over 600 schools have experienced disruptions due to the ongoing demonstrations. Protests are driven by concerns over education standards and teacher shortages.

headline: Woman at centre of Cornell rape inquiry was 'failed' by officials, says New York governor
summary: New York's governor stated that officials failed a woman involved in a Cornell rape inquiry. The woman, identified as Jane Doe, alleges she was raped by seven students in 2024. The alleged incident occurred at a fraternity house on the university campus.

headline: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
summary: Kyiv's mayor, Vitaliy Klitschko, warns of a "very dramatic situation" in the capital. Intensified Russian strikes are targeting critical infrastructure. The ongoing attacks are causing severe damage and disruption across the city.
